summary: A same-tab navigation (the sign-in callback, a reload) left the previous page owning the local database: discarded before its async disconnect told the SharedWorker broker, or frozen in the back/forward cache still holding its OPFS handles. The next page waited on the dead owner and boot hung on "Starting…" (~15s of locked-handle retries, then "did not become ready"). Fixed by releasing the store (terminating the sqlite worker) and leaving the broker synchronously on every pagehide.
